description:
## What

Under the temporal-posture non-negotiable (PKIX-e3nl), the workspace
transcribes spec rules the SPEC ITSELF writes as `notBefore`-keyed (e.g.
SC-081's phased validity cap). This bead audits the current BR set for
similar phased rules, expands the helper catalog, and ships
`*_policy_at_issuance` builder factories that compose them.

## Pattern to expand

Existing prototype: `sc081_validity_cap(not_before_unix) -> u64` in
`pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs`. The function returns the validity cap
that was in force at `not_before_unix`. Used by `pkix-lint`'s
`ValidityMaxLint` so that the cap in force at issuance governs the cert
for its lifetime (not the relying-party-clock cap).

Generalize to other BR rules that are similarly time-keyed.

## Audit scope

Audit the three CA/B Forum BR markdown sources (TLS BR 2.2.6, S/MIME BR
1.0.14, CS BR 3.10.0) for predicates that are written with explicit
effective-date language tying the rule to issuance time, vs cliff-edge
rules that apply to all certs after the date regardless of when issued.

Candidate phased rules to evaluate (need spec-text confirmation each is
notBefore-keyed, not cliff-edge):

- **CS BR §6.3.2** — 460-day subscriber cap (effective 2026-03-01).
  Does the spec say "certs issued after 2026-03-01 must have validity
  ≤ 460d" (phased) or "all CS subscriber certs after 2026-03-01 must
  have validity ≤ 460d" (cliff)?
- **CS BR §6.1.5** — RSA-3072 floor (effective 2023-06-01, raised from
  2048). Same question.
- **S/MIME BR §7.1.6.1 line 2600** — Legacy generation ban (effective
  2025-07-15). Already partially addressed by "we don't ship Legacy
  Profile types" (PKIX-jbvb.7), but a `cabf_smime_legacy_allowed_at_issuance(not_before_unix) -> bool`
  helper would let callers check whether a cert with a Legacy policy
  OID could have been validly issued at its `notBefore`.
- **S/MIME BR §6.3.2** — 825-day Strict cap. If the spec phases this
  separately from prior caps, encode as a helper. Otherwise treat as a
  current-regime constant (already shipped).

For each confirmed-phased rule:

1. Add a pure `*_at(not_before_unix) -> X` helper to
   `pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs` next to `sc081_validity_cap`.
2. Cite the spec section that writes the rule as `notBefore`-keyed.
3. Include the exact effective-date epoch (verified via
   `python3 -c "import calendar; print(calendar.timegm(...))"` as
   `sc081_validity_cap` does).
4. Add unit tests for boundary cases (one second before / exactly at /
   one second after each effective date).

## `*_policy_at_issuance` builders

Add caller-invoked builder functions composing the helpers:

```rust
/// Return a [`ValidationPolicy`] for the current TLS BR regime with all
/// notBefore-keyed predicates resolved against `not_before_unix`. Use
/// this when you want issuance-time semantics for rules the spec
/// writes as phased (e.g. SC-081). For posture against rules in force
/// at a past time (historical-regime replay), this function is the
/// wrong tool; use pkix-policy-zlint.
#[must_use]
pub fn web_pki_policy_at_issuance(now_unix: u64, not_before_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy {
    let mut p = web_pki_policy(now_unix);
    p.max_validity_secs = Some(sc081_validity_cap(not_before_unix));
    p
}

pub fn smime_policy_at_issuance(now_unix: u64, not_before_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy { ... }
pub fn code_signing_policy_at_issuance(now_unix: u64, not_before_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy { ... }
pub fn smime_sponsor_policy_at_issuance(...) -> ValidationPolicy { ... }
pub fn smime_individual_policy_at_issuance(...) -> ValidationPolicy { ... }
```

Use-case-wrapper sibling: if `pkix-chain`'s `verify_*` wrappers want an
`_at_issuance` variant that takes `notBefore` from the leaf cert itself
and resolves automatically, file as a follow-on bead — out of scope
here. Keep this bead focused on the helper + builder layer in
`pkix-profiles-cabf`.

## Acceptance

- Each confirmed-phased BR rule has a `*_at(not_before_unix)` helper
  with cited spec section and boundary unit tests.
- Each Profile type has a sibling `*_policy_at_issuance(now_unix,
  not_before_unix)` builder.
- Rustdoc on the builders documents the contrast with current-regime
  policy() — including pointing to pkix-policy-zlint for historical
  replay.
- CHANGELOG entry under `[Unreleased]`.
- `divergences.md` updated if the audit surfaces any new BR-vs-shipped
  divergences.

## Out of scope

- Adding the same pattern to TLS-EV, EV Code Signing, or other BR
  variants not currently shipped.
- Historical-regime replay against rules with cliff-edge semantics
  (out per PKIX-e3nl).
- Caller-pinnable spec-version Profile types (out per PKIX-e3nl).

## Blocks on

- **PKIX-e3nl** (AGENTS.md temporal-posture non-negotiable) — this bead
  ships the explicit workspace-side implementation of the principle.
  Land the principle first.

## Cross-references

- PKIX-e3nl (non-negotiable codification)
- existing `sc081_validity_cap` in `pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs`
- `pkix-lint::ValidityMaxLint` (existing in-tree consumer of
  `sc081_validity_cap`)
- specs/cabforum-BR.md, specs/cabforum-smime-BR.md,
  specs/cabforum-code-signing-BR.md
title: pkix-profiles-cabf: audit phased-rule helpers and add *_at_issuance builders
